purpose: Authorize a fifth future-only 32-image image-bound v3 E2 lineage using deterministic higher-OOF-confidence selection from the remaining rebuilt prescreen-v2 pool.

evidence.fourth_result: 31 selected and one confirmed collection quality reject; all 124 R0 parent/audit outcomes were delivered and R1/R2 were explicit zero-request closures.
evidence.read_only_selection_audit: Across the first four rebuilt-pool collection lineages P1 selected 108/112 (96.4%). The remaining pool has no P1 rows and offers four per cell with OOF top-1 confidence 0.882-0.936.
evidence.remaining_pool: 192 candidates, 24 per fixed cell, after excluding ten source lineages under image/source/near-duplicate identity.

future_only_changes.source_selection: Select four fresh identities per cell by descending numerical OOF top-1 score, then stable sample ID; exclude all ten preceding source lineages on image/source/near-duplicate identity.

qualification: The selection ordering is a future-only sampling policy, not a change to the 32-row/four-per-cell qualification. Confirmed quality rejections remain terminal and SFT remains separately unauthorized.
